data.long_meaning: Atharth is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'atharva'. It is considered a masculine name and is associated with the deity Atharva, who is one of the Adityas and is known as the 'Lord of the Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Atharva is believed to possess immense power and wisdom, and is often invoked for prosperity, protection, and success.
data.etymology: Atharth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atharth total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

This name is often given to boys to bestow upon them the blessings of the deity Atharva and to help them overcome obstacles and challenges in their lives.

It is believed that invoking the name of this deity can bring about positive energy, prosperity, protection, and success in one's life.
